facts.text: Snow left Burnt Mountain (4,160 ft) and Paradise (5,150 ft) 10 to 20 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Burnt Mountain
evidence.detail: left May 1; earlier seasons: May 20 (2023), May 11 (2024), May 6 (2025)

evidence.name: Paradise
evidence.detail: left June 15; earlier seasons: June 30 (2023), July 11 (2024), July 5 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Burnt Mountain (4,160 ft) and Paradise (5,150 ft).

evidence.name: Burnt Mountain
evidence.detail: 7.4 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 28.8 in (2023), 8.1 in (2024), 12.5 in (2025)

evidence.name: Paradise
evidence.detail: 38.7 in on April 23; earlier seasons: 75.0 in (2023), 61.0 in (2024), 71.8 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 17 and July 22, carried from the melt-out dates at Burnt Mountain (4,160 ft) and Paradise (5,150 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Burnt Mountain
evidence.detail: melted out May 1, 2,021 ft below the pass; points to April 30 to July 12

evidence.name: Paradise
